subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be rebased and adopted on top of current main, or should this PR be narrowed or paused in favor of the newer onboarding direction?
rationale: This is no longer a purely mechanical review because the branch adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while current main and related open PRs have since changed onboarding, setup-code, security-copy, and routing decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the preview-tour direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview-only follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample preview pieces maintainers still want and leave setup-code or connection-path changes to the newer focused PRs.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Leave the branch unmerged if current main plus the newer onboarding/setup PRs are now the desired product direction.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the preview-tour direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, preserved configured-gateway routing, and fresh simulator proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged mobile onboarding/security work changed the same surfaces and is the clearest current-main ownership signal for sequencing this PR.
